title: 3D CT-Inclusive Deep-Learning Model to Predict Mortality, ICU Admittance, and Intubation in COVID-19 Patients.
summary: Full Springer PDF: 3D CT model trained/evaluated on Italian hospital cohorts for mortality, ICU and intubation; external validation reported. CT-only mortality sensitivity was low (about 28%); adding clinical features raised performance, so the result is narrow and cohort-specific. The admission is restricted to this measured result and study setting; it is not evidence of deployment benefit.
